verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a customer lookup endpoint keyed on an external identifier, which returns a 308 Permanent Redirect to the canonical customer record. That supports reconciling customer records with stable IDs from the developer's own system. Nothing in the pack shows external identifiers on case records, and the docs are terse on how external IDs are assigned or guaranteed unique. Missing for 10: external-identifier support for case records, documentation of how external IDs are set and kept stable or unique, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reconcile customer and case records with stable external identifiers
